name: Bazil Thredd
summary: Beneath Stormwind, a Defias prisoner may know what the Brotherhood still intends. After an unsent letter is found in the Deadmines, City Architect Baros Alexston sends you to the Stockade for answers.

sections.title: A Bitter History
sections.body: Baros Alexston and Edwin VanCleef once led the Stonemasons Guild. The masons rebuilt Stormwind after the First and Second Wars. Yet when the white walls and towers were complete, the nobility refused to pay the wages they had promised. Some senior masons received government posts to quiet them. VanCleef would not leave the rank-and-file laborers behind. He led a violent riot out of the city and founded the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Turn to the Stockade
sections.body: Baros Alexston sends you to Bazil Thredd to learn what the Brotherhood still plans against Stormwind. Thredd was VanCleef's chief lieutenant during the mason uprising. Stormwind captured him and confined him in the prison beneath the canals of the Mage Quarter. At the gates, Warden Thelwater warns that the inmates have rebelled. The Stockade is a warzone.

faq.answer: Bazil Thredd was Edwin VanCleef's chief lieutenant in the Stonemasons Guild and the early Defias uprising. Stormwind captured him and imprisoned him deep within the Stockade.

faq.q: Why does Baros Alexston send you to speak with Thredd?
faq.answer: After examining the unsent letter from the Deadmines, Baros Alexston sees a threat to Stormwind beyond the Deadmines. He believes Thredd knows the Brotherhood's inner workings and remaining schemes better than anyone, as VanCleef's former right-hand man.

faq.q: Why was the Stonemasons Guild betrayed?
faq.answer: After the masons rebuilt Stormwind following the Second War, the House of Nobles refused to honor its financial agreements. The laborers went unpaid and were left destitute. VanCleef rejected quiet bribes and led a riot out of the city gates.
The Stockade entrance lies along the canals in Stormwind's northeastern Mage Quarter. Warden Thelwater stands just inside, trying to hold back escaping prisoners.

faq.q: What is happening inside the Stockade when you arrive?
faq.answer: When you arrive, Bazil Thredd and the other inmates have overpowered the guards, unlocked the holding cells, and seized the lower halls. Warden Thelwater struggles to keep the riot from spilling into Stormwind's streets.

faq.q: How did Baros Alexston avoid joining the Defias?
faq.answer: VanCleef chose armed rebellion, while Baros Alexston was among the senior guild craftsmen who accepted government employment. Alexston eventually became City Architect.

angles.text: As a human, you see the Stonemasons Guild's rebellion laid bare the deep political fracture between Stormwind's ruling nobility and the commoners who built the city with their own hands.
As an Alliance hero, you face a Defias threat reaching into the capital through the Stockade's unsecured cells, even with Edwin VanCleef slain.
As a rogue, you know Thredd represents the Defias' hardened, organized underworld branch. Its members traded construction hammers for shanks and street violence.
